nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the black cat and the young child from <Picture 1>: The black cat is a small, fluffy feline with green inner ears and glowing green eyes. When transformed, it becomes a young East Asian child with curly black hair highlighted with bright green tips, wearing a black long-sleeve shirt with green cuffs, baggy grey pants, and black sneakers.
<Subject 2> is the antagonist from <Picture 2>: an arrogant, slender young East Asian man with messy black hair, green highlights, sharp green eyes, wearing a dark ancient-style robe with green accents, jade rings, and tassels. His hands possess sharp, metallic claw-like nails.
<Subject 3> is the rocky wasteland battlefield: a desolate, dusty terrain with jagged rocks under a dramatic, overcast sky.

summary:
[reference generation] A 15-second, 16:9 live-action anime-style fantasy sequence. <Subject 2> cruelly kicks the black cat form of <Subject 1>. The cat transforms into <Subject 1>'s child form in a burst of green light. They fight, but the child is brutally overpowered and beaten down. The final frame freezes on <Subject 2> raising his glowing claw for a finishing blow, with the child collapsed on the ground.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (Shots 1-3): fully_preserved - the black cat's green ears/eyes; the child's curly black hair with green tips, black-green shirt, and grey pants. The transformation must clearly show the cat morphing into the child.
<Subject 2> (Shots 1-3): fully_preserved - his black-green robes, sharp claws, jade rings, and arrogant sneer. He must remain recognizable throughout the brutal beatdown.
<Subject 3> (all shots): partially_preserved - retain the rocky wasteland. Accumulate dust, shattered rocks, and deep cracks from the impacts.

detailed_description:
Photorealistic live-action anime adaptation with feature-film photography. High dynamic range, dramatic lighting, and anime-esque kinetic energy. Maintain a strict spatial axis: the camera stays on the antagonist's side, with the antagonist in the foreground and the protagonist facing the camera from the midground.

[Shot 1] (0-4s) A low-angle wide shot. <Subject 2> stands in the rocky wasteland. <Subject 1> (in black cat form) hisses defensively. With a cruel smirk, <Subject 2> snaps his leg forward in a brutal kick. The black cat is sent flying violently across the dirt, bouncing with a painful yelp. The camera tracks the cat's flight.

[Shot 2] (4-8s) Cut to an Over-the-shoulder (OTS) shot from <Subject 2>'s perspective. In the midground, the tumbling black cat is engulfed in a blinding sphere of emerald-green light. The cat's silhouette distorts, elongating and shaping into <Subject 1>'s child form. The child lands on the ground feet-first, sliding to a halt. The child's green eyes burn with fury, staring directly past the camera at <Subject 2>. A shockwave of green energy blasts dust outward. 

[Shot 3] (8-15s) Cut to a chaotic, fast-paced hand-held tracking shot, circling the fight. The child charges with a heavy right hook. <Subject 2> effortlessly sidesteps and parries with his clawed hands. Sparks fly. <Subject 2> lands a vicious knee to the child's stomach, followed by a dark-energy claw swipe that sends the child crashing into a boulder, shattering it. The child coughs up blood, struggling to stand. Freeze the final frame of this segment: The child collapses to one knee in the midground, exhausted. In the foreground, <Subject 2> laughs coldly, raising his glowing purple clawed right hand high above his head, ready to strike.

overall_soundscape:
The yelp of the kicked cat, followed by the electrical crackle of the transformation. The gritty sounds of fists on flesh and claws tearing the air. A heavy, sickening thud as the child hits the boulder, followed by painful coughing and the ominous hum of dark magic gathering.

non_diegetic_music:
A dark, driving synth-bass and frantic drums during the fight. The music shifts to a tense, high-pitched, dissonant violin as the child is about to be killed, ending on a cliffhanger note.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young child from <Picture 1>: collapsed on one knee in the midground, exhausted, with curly black hair, green tips, black-green shirt, and grey pants.
<Subject 2> is the antagonist from <Picture 2>: in the foreground, standing tall, arrogant, raising his glowing purple clawed right hand high above his head, ready to strike.
<Subject 3> is the master from <Picture 3>: an imposing, calm East Asian man with long dark-blue hair tied in a loose ponytail. He wears a layered blue and grey ancient-style Hanfu robe with a dark blue sash. He wields a long, dark-steel sword and radiates a powerful aura of blinding blue energy.

summary:
[reference generation] A 15-second, 16:9 live-action anime-style fantasy sequence. Continuing directly from the previous video. Just as <Subject 2> is about to deliver a killing blow to <Subject 1>, <Subject 3> appears instantly, blocking the attack. <Subject 3> unleashes a devastating single strike that obliterates <Subject 2>. The final image freezes on the master standing protectively over the child.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (Shot 1): fully_preserved - the child remains in the collapsed state, looking up in awe.
<Subject 2> (Shots 1-2): fully_preserved - his black-green robes and sharp claws. He must remain recognizable until he is blasted away.
<Subject 3> (Shots 2-3): fully_preserved - his long blue hair, blue-grey robes, and dark sword. His appearance must exude absolute authority and blinding speed.

detailed_description:
Photorealistic live-action anime adaptation. The combat shifts from a desperate struggle to an overwhelming display of absolute power. Maintain clear spatial relations: the master steps between the camera/antagonist and the child.

[Shot 1] (15-19s) Cut to a slow-motion extreme close-up, continuing from the frozen frame. <Subject 2>'s glowing purple claw is descending rapidly toward the collapsed child in the midground. The camera is positioned behind the child's shoulder, looking up at the descending claw. The child braces for impact, closing their eyes. The dark purple aura fills the screen.

[Shot 2] (19-23s) Sudden cut to a dramatic wide shot from a side angle. A streak of brilliant BLUE light flashes across the screen. <Subject 3> appears instantly between <Subject 2> (foreground) and the child (midground). He holds his long dark-steel sword horizontally, blocking <Subject 2>'s deadly claw strike with a deafening metallic CLANG. A massive shockwave of blue spiritual energy erupts, blowing <Subject 2> backward through the air and shattering the ground. The camera shakes violently.

[Shot 3] (23-30s) Cut to a high-speed dynamic profile tracking shot. <Subject 3> steps forward and draws his sword in a blindingly fast iaido slash. A massive, blinding arc of blue sword energy cuts across the screen. <Subject 2> is struck mid-air and blasted into a distant rock wall, instantly defeated. <Subject 3> stands tall, robes settling. He turns his back to the defeated enemy (facing the camera and the child) and gently places a hand on the child's head. Freeze the entire image for the final two seconds: <Subject 3> standing protectively with his sword sheathed, looking over his shoulder (towards the defeated enemy) with cold, stoic authority, while the child looks up at him with tears of relief and awe.

overall_soundscape:
A sudden, deafening silence before the master arrives. The sharp, ear-splitting SNAP of the sword block. The roaring hum of blue spiritual pressure. A massive, thunderous boom as the final slash connects. Absolute silence on the final frozen frame, replaced by a gentle wind.

non_diegetic_music:
A tense, high-pitched violin cuts to silence. When <Subject 3> appears, a massive, triumphant and epic orchestral score with heavy brass, taiko drums, and a majestic choir erupts. The music reaches a climactic crescendo during the final slash, then cuts to a powerful, sustained single cello note on the frozen final frame.
